name: Convolutional Decoder with Ray-Patch Querying
definition: A multi-scale upsampling decoder architecture that integrates Ray-Patch querying to generate final image outputs from latent feature representations.
summary: The Convolutional Decoder with Ray-Patch Querying is a multi-scale upsampling architecture that generates images from latent features using fixed nearest-neighbour interpolation and convolutional blocks instead of learned or attention-based methods.
